limitations_and_boundaries: Pretraining data may not fully reflect the complexity of human organ development and health states.
Current model focused on transcriptomic data only, not including genomic or epigenomic data.
Unsupervised pretraining overlooked rich information in metadata.
Batch effects or modality differences are left to cooperative methods on downstream tasks.
Model pretraining loss was not optimized to zero, so predicted gene expression values may have high dropout rate.

methods.name: scFoundation
methods.protocol_description: Large pretrained model with 100 million parameters, asymmetric encoder-decoder architecture (xTrimoGene), pretrained with RDA modeling on over 50 million scRNA-seq profiles. Embedding module converts continuous gene expression scalars into learnable high-dimensional vectors. Encoder processes nonzero and nonmasked embeddings; decoder combines with mask and zero embeddings. Output projected via shared MLP layer.

methods.name: RDA modeling
methods.protocol_description: Pretraining task: mask 30% of genes (both zero and nonzero) in input sample; model predicts expression values at masked positions. Input sample generated via hierarchical Bayesian downsampling or unchanged. Two total count indicators T (target) and S (source) are provided. Loss is regression loss on masked genes.

methods.name: DeepCDR
methods.protocol_description: Baseline drug response prediction model using graph convolutional network. For scFoundation-based version, gene expression replaced with cell-line embeddings from scFoundation.

methods.name: SCAD
methods.protocol_description: Single-cell drug response classification model. For scFoundation-based version, cell embeddings from scFoundation used.

methods.name: GEARS
methods.protocol_description: Perturbation prediction model using Gene Ontology knowledge graph and gene co-expression graph. For scFoundation-based version, gene context embeddings from scFoundation decoder used as node features.
